baselineReproduction.scope: Copied baseline executor close algorithm with controlled interrupt-ignoring task; not a live controller or server.

rules.directoryLease: Acquired before service state load, released from executor termination. A task ignoring interruption keeps the lease and rejects a replacement runtime.
rules.jvmReservation: Real lock path, normalized case on Windows; token stored in system properties and removed only by matching token, shared across plugin classloaders.
rules.osLock: Persistent .worker.lock inode, tryLock rejects other processes; same-JVM contenders are rejected before opening a descriptor to preserve the original POSIX lock.
rules.admissionAndResponses: Shutdown closes executor admission. Queued commands drain during grace, then queued tasks are cancelled. Player response callbacks check controller close state.
rules.data: No schema, replay or engine migration. Atomic persistence remains authoritative. Unstarted queued commands are not durable.

regressions: Bounded queue overflow, ordered drain, post-close rejection, idempotent close and separate-directory independence.
Running commands and scheduled tasks that ignore interruption retain ownership until final work completes.
Forced interruption cancels queued writes; caller interruption remains set after shutdown.
Scheduled lab shutdown runs a final checkpoint on the simulation owner and stops further periodic ticks.
Task failure does not release ownership while the executor replaces the worker and continues queued work.
Independent URLClassLoader models plugin reload and cannot acquire the old runtime directory.
Real ecology files drain to tick 40, restart to 60 and match uninterrupted replay exactly.
Cancelled queued reset does not delete ecology evidence; late active step completes before restart is admitted.
Real lab close saves step 12 on owner thread and next runtime resumes to 13; replay verifies.
